reviews.reason: The complete 14-capability catalogue has been checked. Gather transfers finite exposed stock; probe can inspect or consume a small test sample but does not establish a planted, persistent growing organism. Neither these nor the other listed functions implements cultivation. Develop a general planting-and-tending operation, initially supporting a real root propagation trial where biologically feasible. Edibility does not establish propagation viability. The observed Meadow roots currently have zero exposed stock, not six available units, and neither that source nor the five owned root units may be renewed by declaration. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: The request, development, waiting, naming and three-round individual study yield no pleasure, satisfaction or mastery reward. No success reward for merely issuing cultivate. Verified personally acquired observations, including informative failure, may use the existing information-gain mechanism only after an actual observable event, functionally deduplicated against probe and prior cultivation observations. Do not create a new reward account if none is implemented. Any enabled experience rule must be coded with personal applicability, at most 0.1 short pleasure per qualifying observation, a ten-round same-finding cooldown and ten-round decay to zero; repeated unchanged inspections give zero. Familiar legitimate completed tending may support only an existing modest maintained-satisfaction mechanism, capped at 0.1 attributable benefit, not stacked with the same observation, with eligibility renewed no more than once per ten rounds and decaying at 0.002 per round without qualifying participation. reviews.specification:
General operation: cultivate a plant using parameterized planting, inspection, tending and removal modes, with persistent propagation trials. Retain cultivate-plant@1 and handler long.cultivate-plant as the recorded source of reused planting, escrow, inspection and removal code; record the extension and its dependencies explicitly. Reuse probe for evidence recording and gather/forest.gather for any eventual transfer of ripe, exposed stock. Do not claim these mechanisms as new inventions. Applicable actors may independently learn and operate the extension; no automatic mastery or participation is granted.
References and prerequisites: target is an exact visible plant or plot ID; inputStackId is an exact owned material stack; processId identifies the actor's persistent job; x/y identify a reachable, unoccupied ordinary-soil site. Species/material compatibility must be checked, not inferred from an item's name or food value. start-0-roots at (10.1,12) is the observed source reference, with current stock zero, not a free supply. item-3-lin-12 is a possible input, subject to live ownership, remaining quantity, spoilage and actual suitability checks. Known nutrition 14 and toxicity zero do not prove viability, rooting, environmental tolerance or reproductive mode. The tick-9 visible-state record is an observation, not verified evidence of propagation.
Smallest executable addition: connect persistent planted material to a substrate, exposure and organism-state model that can resolve a real propagation trial, and expose only supported tending actions. Before release, the development handoff must inspect the existing source-growth, environmental-decay and simulation-time implementation and implement the missing causal transitions. Establish executable species parameters for viable propagules, suitable conditions, establishment duration, growth, resource demands, failure and harvestable production. These are world-mechanism definitions to validate in the handoff, not facts awarded to Lin. Do not select positive viability merely to satisfy this request. If the actual material cannot propagate, trials must show the supported failure; implement only an alternative propagation mode supported by actual available biology and real inputs. If biological support remains unresolved, preserve the trial as unresolved, with an explicit implementation blocker; do not report biological failure or silently ship the existing never-growing plot as the completed addition.
Costs and work: preserve planting at one actual unspoiled root unit, two work rounds and one energy per completed work round. Material moves into escrow once, then into the plot on completion; splitting a stack deducts the same quantity and retains its age and provenance. Inspection costs one round and 0.2 energy. Removal costs one round and one energy, with the existing planter restriction. Each supported tending intervention costs at least one work round and one energy, plus its actual consumed inputs. A minimal hand-tending mode may clear physically present competing vegetation from a small reachable plot; it must transfer that biomass to a recorded residue or waste state and may improve only a modeled competition term. It cannot create moisture, nutrients, viable tissue or food. Watering is enabled only with an implemented owned water source and transfer mechanism, and debits exactly the applied amount. Unsupported modes fail validation without costs or success effects. No tools, water, seeds, fertilizer or additional root units are supplied by development.
Growth costs and timing are not currently known. The handoff must supply positive executable establishment and growth durations in simulation rounds, actual temperature/moisture limits, resource demands, and per-interval production and capacity bounds before growth can execute. Derive these from inspected existing mechanisms where applicable; record any newly authored rules explicitly. Do not invent a maturity deadline in this review. All growth must require elapsed world time under those rules, with no progress during development/review waiting. The extension must maintain state for living tissue, remaining original material, moisture, environmental exposure, elapsed eligible growth, damage, decay and harvestable stock. Existing material continues ageing during trials. Photosynthetic production, if supported, must debit modeled environmental energy and water/nutrient availability and account for biomass, respiration and waste; soil fertility is not an infinite hidden food source. Reuse existing source-growth accounting where compatible, with an explicit ledger preventing both source and plot from crediting the same production. Harvest depletes actual ripe stock and costs the existing gather rate of two energy per unit. Any resulting edible root units retain their actual nutrition/toxicity rules; eating still uses eat and never substitutes mood for nutrition.
Persistence and settlement: store resolved references, allocated quantities, work paid, remaining work and process status. Interruption preserves paid progress and surviving escrow; resumption validates reach, ownership and inputs and charges only unfinished work. Cancellation releases surviving unplanted material once, with spent energy/time never refunded. Death settles unfinished escrow to ground once. Already planted material remains a physical plot on interruption, cancellation or planter death and continues ordinary environmental processes; removal returns only physically surviving recoverable material. No operation restores decay losses or manufactures replacement inputs. Failed validation spends nothing; failure after real work retains actual costs and damage. Maintenance is conditional on measured modeled needs, not a mandatory invented chore schedule. Neglect changes growth or survival only through implemented causal conditions. Established transitions, eligibility, accounting, caps and evidence checks execute in code without repeated model review.

Reusable visual metadata should include processId, resource, source item lineage, treatment/control role, position, quantities, work completed/required, timestamp, observed condition, evidence reference and status such as preparing, exposed, interrupted, spoiled, retrieved or inconclusive. Only render moisture values or contamination details that the observing actor can actually measure; internal model state is not automatically visible. Show actual bark supports and distinguish the samples without claiming that a label changes food. A completed lesson or elapsed timer cannot display preserved/safe/success. If validated evidence supports longer usability, show the specific measured comparison and limitations rather than universal safety. Failed or incomplete setup remains visibly failed or incomplete, and no inspection reveals hidden resources or unknown stock.
reviews.specification:
General operation: controlled-food-processing-trial, parameterized by mode (start, inspect, resume, cancel, retrieve), owned food stack references, quantity, treatment (initially whole-food passive air-drying), workspace coordinates and processId. Applicable actors study separately. Initial executable protocol uses one whole unit as treatment and one whole unit of the same resource and comparable existing age/decay as an untreated comparison; maximum initial batch is two food units. No cutting, heating, salting, fermentation or sealed storage is implied. A one-unit exposure trial may be allowed when only one unit is available, but must report the absence of a matched control and cannot establish comparative extension of usability.
Exact current references: Sol owns item-4-sol-17, root quantity 5, quantityTenths 50, harvestedAt 4, recorded decay 6.98365183. Root nutrition 14 and toxicity 0 are known starting properties, not evidence that future spoiled roots remain safe. Berry nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 are known, but Sol owns no supplied berry stack. start-2-roots has stock 0 and supplies nothing; cultivate-plant cannot replenish it. start-2-berries, start-2-branches and forest-bark-2 are observed possible sources, not inventory grants. Existing gather transfers finite source stock at 2 energy per unit after actual travel into interaction range. Existing navigate, gather, probe, eat, pickup and drop handlers must be reused where applicable, with their references and revisions recorded in the implementation manifest; preserve foundation-forest@1 attribution where supplied.
Prerequisites and material costs: two owned unspoiled units of known-safe food, two owned intact bark pieces, two owned branches, and an accessible stable workspace with two separate positions. The proposed minimal support is two unsealed bark surfaces supported above soil by the branches, with no bindings, cutting or assumed tools. Implementation must validate actual material geometry, stability, food contact suitability and cleanliness from physical state. Bark is not automatically sanitary. If these checks cannot be implemented for available materials, do not consume food or fabricate a rack: return the unmet physical prerequisite and admit the necessary support preparation/contact-safety mechanism into this same development handoff. Materials must first be obtained; acquiring two branches and two bark pieces with gather costs 8 energy plus travel and elapsed rounds, subject to real stock and applicability. Materials remain real recoverable objects rather than being converted into free equipment.
Learning: 3 simulation rounds after implementation, with normal metabolism and no granted mastery before completion. Setup: two work rounds at 1 energy each to place and validate supports, followed by two work rounds at 1 energy each to allocate and place treatment and comparison food. Total setup is four work rounds and 4 energy, excluding acquisition, travel and learning. Validate and disclose the full plan before committing food. Reserve exactly the selected units, preserving origin, age, decay and all existing state; never reset freshness on splitting or transfer. For Sol, a two-root trial leaves three roots outside the experiment, each continuing ordinary ageing. Treatment and comparison use distinct positions under the same ambient conditions; expose the treatment on a validated raised, ventilated surface and leave the comparison under the existing ordinary ground-storage conditions. Record this difference explicitly; it tests the complete exposure/storage treatment, not drying alone. No perfectly matched environment or scientific certainty is fabricated.
Processing dependency: implement or reuse a versioned per-resource food-state model before enabling any changed shelf life. It must account for initial dry matter and water, elapsed simulation time, measured ambient temperature, moisture or humidity, ventilation, rain/wetting, contact contamination and spoilage. The current packet supplies no drying coefficients, validated safe moisture threshold or complete spoilage model. Obtain these from implementation facts if present; otherwise develop the missing moisture/spoilage mechanism in this handoff and disclose its numeric rates, units, supported resource profiles, safe-use criteria and maximum observation horizon before execution. Do not silently invent calibrated constants or reinterpret the existing decay number as moisture. Whole roots or berries may dry too slowly, rewet, contaminate or spoil before useful drying. If no defensible resource-specific drying model is available yet, enable only the paired exposure-and-observation precursor: both samples retain existing decay rules, and no preserved status, safety certification or extended lifetime is awarded. This precursor is an actual finite-material experiment, not a roadmap or an unlock gated by an arbitrary era.
Ongoing work: after setup, exposure runs each actual simulation round until cancellation, retrieval, spoilage exhaustion or a predeclared endpoint of 10 exposure rounds. Ten rounds is an observation checkpoint, not a promised processing duration or preservation threshold. No active energy is charged merely for passive exposure; elapsed time and metabolism still occur. Inspection is one round and 0.2 energy at the existing observation interface's reachable distance, reusing its handler where supported. Work requires the operator within reach; leaving or interruption pauses unfinished manual work at its completed round boundary without duplicating costs. Passive exposure, decay, rain and contamination continue while unattended. Rain or unsuitable conditions can defeat the treatment; protection, cleaning, turning and repairs are not automatic. Any extra action needs a disclosed implemented cost and real material prerequisites.
Conservation and effects: food dry matter and any existing nutritional content are conserved except documented physical losses or spoilage; water leaving food enters the environment, and wetting transfers actual environmental water under the implemented model. Drying cannot multiply root nutrition 14 or berry nutrition 8, make new servings, remove toxins by declaration or reset age. Nutrition is applied by the existing eat handler only to actually consumed remaining edible material, with appropriate fractional accounting if the engine supports it; otherwise preserve whole-unit accounting without rounding gains. Spoiled matter remains identified waste unless a real removal process exists. Supports suffer only implemented wear/contamination and require actual repair or replacement if damaged. Outputs are surviving treatment food, surviving comparison food, any actual spoiled matter, the placed supports and a provenance-linked observation record. Successful preservation requires the implemented physical state and observed evidence; absence of visible mould alone cannot certify safety. No roots grow or sources refill.
Interruption and settlement: setup progress and payments persist by processId. Cancel or failed validation releases only surviving reserved food and unused materials exactly once; already placed supports remain in place. Retrieve costs one work round and 1 energy per food batch, checks reach and ownership, and transfers only actual remaining contents. Cancel after placement stops further scheduled work, not natural ageing or weather exposure, and does not teleport food to inventory. Completed work, consumed energy, elapsed time, moisture loss and spoilage are never refunded. Death releases reserved items locally according to existing death handling, leaves placed objects and samples in the world, and does not restore spoiled food. Passive environmental processes continue independently. Global review/development waiting advances no time; simulation pauses freeze all progress and environmental updates. Implement validation, rates, reservations, ownership, progress, settlements and deduplication in code rather than sending established rules back for repeated model judgment.

args.conditions: I am outdoors in mild spring conditions on ordinary soil. Several visible fallen-branch sources exist nearby. I have no demonstrated shelter, tools, construction materials in inventory, or construction mastery. Future weather protection is a precaution, not a currently observed emergency.
args.inputs: Potentially gathered branches and a suitable unoccupied site; required quantities, other materials and tools are unknown. Do not grant missing inputs.
args.costs: Learning time, construction labor, energy, material costs and upkeep must be explicit and paid; their amounts are currently unknown.
args.effects: Enable actual shelter construction only after required learning and material acquisition, with persistent paid work and clear cancellation rules. reviews.reason: The supplied search and registry review found no equivalent shelter-building or exposure-reduction operation. gather already supplies loose-material collection; probe supplies observation and small physical trials. Planting and food-exposure trials do not construct weather barriers. Develop the missing construction and maintenance mechanism through the current-conversation handoff, reusing those existing operations rather than claiming their reinvention. Lin has neither qualified building materials nor demonstrated construction mastery. Visible fallen branches are potential sources, not inventory or verified suitable stock. A small branch windbreak is a feasible minimal shelter; rainproof roofing, enclosed housing and emergency protection are not established. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Proposed learning is four individual study rounds, 0.2 energy per completed round, with resumable paid study progress through learn; no automatic learning on approval. Learning, requests, registration, naming and mastery confer no experiential reward. For the minimal implementation add no new pleasure or satisfaction award: construction progress alone is not evidence of experienced comfort. Genuine observed protection or informative structural failure may use the existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback only when actually measured and personally applicable, preserving that system's bounded amount, cooldown and decay; if its contract cannot be verified, issue no such award. Familiar maintenance can remain legitimate useful activity without inventing novelty bonuses. Any future maintained satisfaction requires its own coded event eligibility, shared functional deduplication and caps rather than a reward per repair. Keep basic nutrition, protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions unchanged.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable work-started, material-embedded, paused, resumed, cancelled, completed, inspected, exposure-changed, repaired, dismantled and collapsed events with actor, tick, site/target IDs, recipe version, paid progress and observable input/output changes. Store reusable renderer metadata: component branch-screen, dimensions, orientation, construction fraction, integrity band, unfinished/complete/damaged/collapsed state, lee-side footprint and current measured protection-active flag. Show actual partial geometry for unfinished work and weathered or collapsed geometry as condition changes. Protection indicators require an eligible occupant, actual directional wind and successful environmental computation; calm weather, failed placement, missing materials, unfinished work and unsupported coupling must never display protection success. Private or unobserved resource facts must not appear in visuals or events delivered to observers. Completion means a real built screen, not proof of rain protection or a guaranteed positive comfort experience.
reviews.specification:
Develop a general capability named Construct and maintain a weather barrier, parameterized by site, orientation, owned input stack IDs, target structure/process ID and mode: build, resume, inspect, repair, cancel or dismantle. Initial supported design: a freestanding, densely interlaced branch screen with a one-person lee-side resting footprint, not a waterproof roof. Development must implement its physical structure and environmental coupling before publishing a working interface; review and implementation waiting advance no simulation time. If source materials or environmental exposure integration are unavailable, report the exact unsupported condition and perform no successful construction or protection. Do not substitute a decorative object.
Prerequisites: individual completion of learning; reachable, unoccupied ordinary-soil footprint, 2 m by 1 m, with a clear adjacent 1 m by 1 m lee-side space; soil that accepts driven stakes; no interference with other occupants, entrances or access rights. Check placement against actual collision and bounds. No tools are assumed. The hand-driven design is restricted to demonstrably workable soil and branches; otherwise it cannot start. Use probe's existing observation/test behavior when qualification needs an actual test, charging its existing costs, and record code reuse. Never infer mechanical suitability from a resource name.
Proposed executable material recipe: 12 whole, sound branch units, each with recorded length at least 1.2 m and diameter between 1 and 3 cm: four stakes and eight interwoven members. Qualify flexibility, integrity and hand-workability from public material properties or paid physical testing. These are input requirements, not assertions about local branches. Existing gather transfers only finite exposed source stock, at its existing 2 energy per unit and range conditions; gathering, travel and recovery are separate actual actions. Food stacks item-3-lin-12 and item-19-lin-87 are not substitutes. Where current branch records lack necessary physical properties, the handoff must add a truthful material representation/qualification mechanism, not generate suitable branches. No cordage, tools, new source stock or roofing material is granted.
Build costs eight successful work rounds at 2 energy per round, plus the 12 qualified branch units. Validate and reserve exact owned units and the site atomically on the first paid work action. No remote construction. After each round store worker, site, orientation, recipe version, input IDs and quantities, paid energy and completed steps. Rounds 1-2 place stakes, rounds 3-8 interweave members; material accounting records each embedded member. Completed branches remain structure contents rather than also remaining in inventory. No unworked or partially worked screen provides registered shelter protection. Lin's current energy does not imply the ability to pay gathering, travel and construction without recovery. Ordinary hunger, ageing and weather continue during actual learning and work rounds. Never debit below affordable energy or invent nutrition.
On completion create a persistent structure with actual collision geometry, anchored location, orientation, branch inventory, integrity 100, capacity one and a bounded lee-side polygon. The environmental integration must derive a local wind-exposure component from actual weather. While an actor independently occupies the unobstructed lee-side polygon, wind comes through the screen toward that polygon, and integrity is at least 25, reduce only that wind-exposure component by 30% times integrity/100. Blend direction continuously to zero for side-on or reversed wind. Do not reduce ambient temperature, rain, wet-ground exposure, hunger or all-purpose hazard damage. There is no rainproofing, heating, food production or guaranteed rest bonus. If no wind component exists, implement that minimal coupling in the handoff or explicitly mark protection unavailable; do not apply an unexplained global exposure multiplier. Log the actual before/after wind contribution whenever the effect changes. In calm mild conditions a completed screen can have zero current protective effect. Overlapping barriers use the strongest applicable reduction, not multiplication. Any physical comfort contribution must remain within the global cap of 10.
Maintain integrity in code: lose 0.05 integrity per elapsed outdoor simulation round, plus 0.05 times normalized actual wind intensity in [0,1] and 0.05 times normalized actual rain intensity in [0,1]. Do not fabricate weather observations; absent weather channels contribute zero and remain declared limitations. Integrity is clamped to [0,100]; below 25 no protection, at zero mark collapsed and retain the same physical material as damaged debris. Ageing persists unattended; no automatic maintenance or energy drain from the builder. Inspect uses probe's one-round, 0.2-energy direct-observation path and reports only visible structure condition and actual locally measurable effects. Repair requires access to the structure, one new qualified branch unit and two work rounds at 1 energy each; replace one existing member and add at most 10 integrity, capped at 100. Return the replaced member as one damaged, nonqualifying branch unit. Reject repair at full integrity without spending resources. Branch ageing/damage must be represented so repair or rebuilding cannot reset degraded material for free.
Interruption pauses work with paid progress and reserved inputs retained; environmental damage and material ageing continue. Resume rechecks reach, occupancy, material condition and prerequisites, retaining valid paid progress and charging only new work. Cancel releases unembedded reserved inputs exactly once; installed materials remain in the unfinished structure with no protective effect until completed. Never refund spent rounds, energy or learning. Death stops work, releases reservations as actual ground items and leaves embedded materials and any completed structure in place; no duplicate refund or automatic inheritance of learning. Dismantle requires two rounds at 1 energy each, disables protection when dismantling starts, and returns only the recorded surviving branch contents at their current condition. Paused dismantling retains its state. Destruction and weather damage transfer or degrade real contents rather than producing replacement stock. No expiry or cancellation deletes accounted material without an explicit physical loss record.
Each worker must independently learn, communicate and choose paid actions; the initial implementation need not support joint work. No request authorizes another actor's labor or transfers ownership. Record reuse of gather, probe, normal inventory transfers, learn, collision checks and any available persistent-work/event infrastructure. New code is limited to the missing barrier assembly, material condition, ongoing integrity and directional exposure coupling. Execute established checks, costs and effects deterministically in code, not through repeated model review.

reviews.specification: Reuse probe (equivalence open-baseline:probe:1, handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1). Supply target as a currently visible, nearby subject reference, mode='observe', intensity=0; for example forest-plum-2 or start-2-nuts, provided the actor is actually within observation reach. The same operation applies to other accessible sources and samples, not just these instances. Revalidate visibility, reach and target existence at execution; remembered locations alone are insufficient. If necessary, the actor must separately navigate using actual travel time and energy. One completed observation takes one simulation round and 0.2 energy, with no material, reagent, tool, fuel or food cost. There are no prerequisites in the contract, but the actor must individually possess or learn the ability before execution; public registration does not grant mastery. No gathering is necessary for this version. Do not invoke press, wet or heat as part of observation, and do not assume water, heat, equipment or owned samples. Record only externally observable features actually supported by the handler, with target, time, method and evidence-event reference. Existing visible stock/stage information may be reobserved, but labels such as plum or hazelnut and a mature appearance do not establish species identification, edibility or safety. If no additional observable feature is supported, explicitly report that limitation rather than inventing an analysis. Keep visible-state observations distinct from unresolved toxicity, allergens, contamination, internal decay, digestibility and nutrient content; never expose hidden resource fields. Retain the unverified status of personal observations unless an existing verification rule independently warrants a stronger status. The operation neither consumes nor creates material: source stock and owned stacks, including item-4-sol-17 and item-27-sol-127, remain unchanged. It gives no nutrition, healing, detoxification or safety certification. Execution is one atomic interaction, not a persistent experiment. Interruption or cancellation before completion follows probe's cancel rule, yields no completed finding and retains no resumable work; a later attempt is a new paid interaction. Death likewise prevents completion. No spent time or energy is refunded, and no unperformed interaction may be charged as completed. There is no material reservation or material refund. Existing ambient growth and inventory decay continue normally during actual elapsed rounds; no new ongoing process, maintenance burden or physical product is introduced. reviews.reason: Develop functional air-drying in the existing current-conversation handoff. The supplied related-capability searches and registry identify no equivalent: controlled-food-processing-trial explicitly leaves decay unchanged, cultivate-plant also retains ordinary decay, and gathering or moving food does not preserve it. The current world has no implemented drying mechanism, so preservation is not presently available. That missing mechanism warrants development rather than permanent rejection or another observation-only substitute. Successful preservation must remain conditional on actual materials, food properties and drying conditions; ordinary outdoor soil alone is insufficient. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: No pleasure, satisfaction or other reward for requesting, review, registration, learning, starting a batch, elapsed waiting, naming a product or obtaining a preserved label. Setup alone is not verified information gain. An inspection may use existing evidence-deduplicated observation feedback only when a real accessible measurement or visible change supplies personally new, verified information, including informative failure; internal water or decay values must not become free knowledge. Any additional experience hook must be separately implemented with real event evidence, personal applicability, explicit amount/cap, decay and cooldown, and functional deduplication against the existing observation system. Until such a bounded hook exists, this operation awards none. Do not modify protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions. Retained nutrition follows the food's actual nutrients and is not reduced by mood; no physical-comfort increase is granted.
reviews.visualReview: Emit reusable structured events for setup work, interruption, actual food placement, observed drying or wetting, spoilage, inspection, retrieval, cancellation and material release. Include eventId, tick, actor when applicable, processId, food/support references, actual location, visible quantity and phase, with observation/evidence references where appropriate. Reuse existing item and process renderers and record that reuse. Show real food on its real support only after placement; visible shrinkage or texture changes must follow simulated material changes and be limited to observable properties. A pending or failed setup cannot display dried food, completion effects or preservation success. Completion cues require an achieved configured drying endpoint, not an elapsed timer, and do not certify safety or permanent preservation. Unattended ongoing processes remain visible when observable; hidden moisture, safety or environmental state is not disclosed by visual metadata.
reviews.specification:
General operation: air-dry food, parameterized by owned inputStackId, quantity, supportId/location and modes set-up, inspect, retrieve, resume and cancel. Applicable to any actor who individually learns it. Initial scope is whole food whose implemented material properties permit air-drying without cutting; no cutting tools, fire, salt, containers or storage buildings are implied. Implement this operation and its missing moisture/decay mechanism together before exposing it as usable. Do not merely rename the existing ground-exposure trial or attach a preserved label to unchanged food.
References and prerequisites: candidates include root stack item-3-moss-12, quantity 3, recorded decay 31.2865681, and berry stack item-17-moss-78, quantity 5, recorded decay 17.01287737. Revalidate ownership, remaining quantity, location, reach, spoilage and recorded food applicability at execution. The packet establishes these foods as nontoxic; drying does not establish additional safety. Hazelnut item-29-moss-139 is not an eligible known-safe food on the supplied evidence. A physically suitable, stable, uncontaminated, exposed stone support must actually exist and be accessible; bare soil is not an equivalent. start-1-stone is a remembered finite stone source, not an already owned or prepared drying surface. Reuse gather to obtain real material if needed, paying its existing 2 energy per unit and decrementing source stock; reuse navigate for actual travel at its existing costs. Source stock does not certify a gathered piece's shape or cleanliness. Validate those properties and usable area from the actual material. If no suitable support exists, setup fails without creating one; unsupported cleaning, cutting or fabrication requires its own actual mechanism, not an implied prerequisite grant.
Costs and work: study takes 4 simulation rounds, individually. Setup takes two active work rounds at 1 energy each for a batch of up to one food unit and reserves one real suitable stone piece with enough exposed area; larger batches require proportionate support area and two work rounds/2 energy per food unit, with fractional quantities charged proportionately and work accrued continuously. No food is consumed as a setup fee. The stone remains a recoverable physical support, not a consumed ingredient. Inspect costs one round and 0.2 energy. Retrieve costs one round and 1 energy per batch. Drying takes additional elapsed simulation time, not study or review time, and cannot promise a completion deadline before environmental conditions are known. Passive drying consumes no actor energy; heat comes from actual ambient/radiative exchange, not free heat. Food continues to age during learning, travel, setup and drying.
Required minimal mechanism: add conserved water and non-water food components, exposed area, food-specific moisture transport, and a moisture-dependent spoilage rule. Initialize material components from explicit food definitions and the actual remaining food, never by restoring quantity, nutrition or freshness. Before release, define numerical moisture, transport, safe operating bounds and spoilage parameters for each supported food in executable configuration; do not silently declare roots or berries dryable without such definitions. At every simulation step compute evaporation from exposed area, food moisture, ambient temperature and air moisture; bound it by available water and the heat available for vaporization. Transfer evaporated water to the environment and debit the corresponding heat. Implement the minimum local air-moisture/heat exchange state if absent; do not assume dry weather or reveal hidden environmental values through this review. Rain or humid conditions can halt drying or cause modeled water uptake. Run spoilage using the same environmental baseline as ordinary food, multiplied by a configured, bounded moisture-dependent factor that is below 1 only when actual moisture reduction warrants it. No reduction merely for placement or active process status. Record the counterfactual baseline increment alongside the applied increment for internal verification, without presenting it as a physically observed control sample. Existing accumulated decay never decreases. Drying must not remove toxins, reverse spoilage, sterilize food, or guarantee safe storage. Reject food already ineligible for consumption rather than rehabilitating it. If the implementation cannot yet supply this mechanism, keep the feature pending development and plainly report that no functional preservation has occurred.
Conservation and products: keep food identity and a single accountable allocation across inventory, reserved inputs and the support. Split stacks without duplicating their components or resetting age. The product is the same food with less water, changed mass and only its retained non-water nutrients; do not increase total available nutrition or convert water loss into lost edible units. Attribute any real spoilage losses to explicit waste. Integration with eat, pickup, drop and give must retain moisture, accumulated decay and ownership semantics. Returned stone is the original remaining stone, not a replacement.
Lifecycle: setup records personal processId, reserved inputs and paid work. Interruption preserves work and reservations; uncompleted setup grants no drying benefit, and its food ages in its actual location. Resume revalidates access and remaining inputs. Cancel releases each surviving reservation exactly once, without refunding spent time or energy. Death releases reserved surviving materials at their real location and ends personal work. Once food is physically laid out, drying, wetting and spoilage continue unattended, including after cancellation of monitoring or the operator's death. Retrieval changes exposure according to the actual destination; it does not grant dry storage. Keep moisture-dependent effects on the food itself, not dependent on an active operator. No ongoing fuel or automatic maintenance is charged; turning, moving, sheltering or cleaning is not silently performed. Continued suitability depends on actual support cleanliness, exposure, weather and food condition. A damaged or contaminated support and rewetting can end the benefit. Other actors do not automatically help, maintain the batch, transfer ownership or communicate observations.
Implementation reuse: record exact reuse of gather, navigate, learn, eat and applicable existing item-transfer/decay code in the development change record. Reuse compatible process reservation, interruption and observation components from controlled-food-processing-trial where available, recording which code is reused. This is a new moisture-dependent processing effect, not reinvention of those existing operations. Validate lifecycle and conservation in code; established rules must execute without recurrent model approval. Development and review waiting advance no simulation time, grant no inventory and confer no mastery.

reviews.reason: The searched registry covers gathering, dropping, observation, sample trials and ordinary rest, but not a persistent recoverable loose-material resting-pad trial. Cultivate-plant and controlled-food-processing-trial have different inputs and effects; their process-management code can be reused, not represented as a new invention. Develop a general loose-material pad trial, initially supporting owned moss as a recoverable ground arrangement. This is a feasible precursor, not certification of bedding. The failed load test does not rule out a ground-supported loose arrangement, but establishes neither body support nor insulation, cleanliness or comfort. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Three study rounds are required individually after implementation; review grants no mastery. Requests, registration, naming, study, setup and recovery earn no pleasure or satisfaction. Minimal implementation adds no new experience award: genuine new observations, including informative failures, may use only the existing probe evidence-deduplication path with its implemented personal applicability, bounded awards, cooldown and decay. If that path lacks an applicable rule, award zero rather than invent one. Rechecking the known failed press or repeatedly resting on unchanged moss is not new verified information. Physical recovery is the actual rest effect, not an experience reward. No comfort increase is supported; physical comfort remains subject to its cap of 10. No mood adjustment reduces basic nutrition needs, and no protected reward account, budget, goal or permission changes.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable events only for committed transitions: work started/progressed/paused/resumed/cancelled, material placed, inspection recorded, rest completed and remaining material recovered. Reusable visual metadata includes component loose-material-patch, material, actual quantity, footprint, position, provenance, completion state, occupancy and event IDs. A work marker or reserved-material marker must be visibly distinct from a completed patch. Moss coloration may derive from the observed material, but visual softness is not evidence of comfort. Display unsupported, blocked and interrupted states truthfully; no success pad before placement commits, and no warm, clean, comfortable or restorative badge without implemented measurement. Rest visuals occur only during actual rest and completed recovery displays only the measured result. Removal clears the patch only after its committed transfer.
reviews.specification:
Current-conversation development handoff: implement a general operation named arrange-resting-material with modes arrange, inspect, trial-rest, remove, resume and cancel. Parameters are mode, inputStackId, quantity, x/y, target and processId as applicable; do not bind it to Sol, this stack or this source. Initially admit moss only for loose, ground-supported placement; additional materials require explicit implemented applicability rules. Prerequisites: individual study after implementation, an actually reachable unoccupied ordinary-ground site within 0.65 plus body radius, ownership and physical access to the selected stack, and enough energy for each work step. Check occupancy and ownership again at commit. This grants no movement, tools, harvesting, ownership of a site or missing materials. No frame, binding or elevated load support is required or claimed.
Arrange accepts positive quantities in 0.1-unit increments, minimum 0.1, default 0.5, limited by actual available input. It creates a small loose-material trial patch, not a guaranteed body-sized bed. Use a 0.25-radius placement footprint for occupancy and rendering only; do not infer thickness, coverage, body fit or comfort from quantity. Setup takes two active work rounds at one energy per completed round, with the selected real quantity reserved once. Commit transfers that surviving quantity into one persistent patch; it does not duplicate or consume it as fuel. No tools, water, branches or additional material are supplied. If the ground-placement prerequisite cannot be implemented, return the precise unsupported operation and leave material unchanged rather than display a constructed pad. Development and review waiting consume no world time.
Inspect takes one round and 0.2 energy at reach, delegating existing probe observation semantics. Report visible placement, remaining quantity, occupancy and recorded tests; material quality and unknown properties stay unknown. It cannot infer sanitation, warmth, insulation or suitability. Trial-rest requires a completed nearby patch, the actor actually at its location, and no other occupant. It executes exactly one existing rest action: one round, base energy recovery 4 modified only by actually accessible registered facilities and capped at 40. Do not register this loose patch as a beneficial facility. Record actual pre/post energy, elapsed round, relevant accessible facility modifiers and patch identity. An ordinary-ground reference uses the same operation with no patch target, with independent movement required if needed. A comparison may report observed differences and confounders, not causal comfort or health findings. Never bypass rest's existing hunger, environmental or other simulation updates. Extra inspections are separate paid actions. The actor independently chooses whether to rest or compare; do not manufacture participation.
Remove requires the placing actor, reach and an unoccupied patch; it takes one round and one energy and returns only its remaining material to an owned stack at that site, not remotely into inventory. Pickup remains a separate existing action. Removal deletes the empty patch and ends its trial, retaining evidence records. It produces no replacement moss or clean-material certification. Record constituent stack provenance, quantity and any existing applicable ageing or material-state rules. While unattended the patch persists and participates in applicable existing ground/environment updates; elapsed time alone grants no benefit or replenishment. Do not invent decay or contamination rates. No ongoing energy charge, growth, automatic rest or comfort aura exists. Maintenance in this minimal version is inspection followed, if desired, by paid removal and rearrangement of surviving material; there is no free repair or automatic top-up.
Each process stores operator, resolved input IDs, site, reserved surviving quantity, completed work rounds, paid energy, status and idempotent transfer markers. Interruption pauses unfinished setup with completed work retained and no passive progress or energy expenditure; resume revalidates access and site and pays only unfinished steps. Cancel releases surviving escrow once as owned ground material at the work site; completed patches instead require removal. Death stops active work, releases surviving escrow once onto the ground and leaves a completed patch physically present under existing death/ownership rules, without fabricating an heir or permission. Atomic inspect, removal and rest apply only on completed executions; interrupted unpaid/uncommitted effects are absent, and any committed material transfer must not repeat. Spent rounds, energy, consumed material from separate probes and real environmental losses are never refunded. Global pause preserves state.
Exact references: rest, equivalence base:rest:1, handler forest.rest, revision foundation-forest@1; probe, equivalence open-baseline:probe:1; cultivate-plant, equivalence cultivation:root-trial:plant-inspect-remove:1; controlled-food-processing-trial, equivalence food:paired-ground-exposure:observation-trial:1; and existing navigate, pickup, gather and learn for their own actions. Record reused process, escrow, observation and rest handlers in implementation provenance. Applicant evidence is knowledge moss:load response:load-band-0, event-38-sol-188: a separate 0.1-material press at load 0.3 returned held=false and flexibility=0.8. It is not an unperformed bedding test. Sol's candidate input is item-37-sol-183, 0.9 moss at the recorded location, from forest-moss-2; validate current access and surviving quantity at execution. Do not debit or harvest the source's observed stock automatically. The default setup would transfer 0.5 and leave 0.4 in the original stack if unchanged; removal can recover no more than what remains in the patch.

reviews.specification:
General operation: make-and-test-cordage, parameterized by mode, inputStackId or productId, quantity, preparation method, bounded test load and processId. Modes: prepare, form, test, inspect, resume, cancel and recover-material. Applicable actors may learn it independently; do not specialize the interface to Sol or this vine stack. Reuse and record the existing ownership, reach, inventory-transfer, learning, work-process, event and observation implementations where available. Reuse probe/open.probe for genuine observation or its supported sample trials, with its original costs and limitations; a press response is not tensile strength. Do not claim reused code as a new invention.
Prerequisites and development dependencies: accessible owned material, free hands and sufficient energy; validate actual reach and current condition at execution. The present candidate is item-62-sol-314, resource vine, quantity 2, origin forest-vine-2. It is not an instruction to reserve or consume it now. No further gathering, tools, water, resin, fixtures or test weights are supplied. Implement an explicit, auditable material-behavior and hand-manipulation contract sufficient to determine strand continuity, workable length, flexibility, joining behavior and response to tension. Use supported world properties and actual measured evidence; do not invent favorable properties from the resource name. If these mechanisms are not yet available, implement the smallest real precursor: a paid preparation attempt that manipulates an owned sample, records observable bending/separation results and returns the physically remaining material. An unsupported measurement must be labeled unsupported rather than given a numerical result. The development handoff must resolve these dependencies before enabling successful cord or strength outputs; waiting for development does not advance the world.
Executable costs: prepare reserves quantity in 0.1-unit increments, minimum 0.1 and no more than the accessible owned balance; default 1 unit. Preparation takes one active work round and 0.5 energy. Forming takes two further active work rounds at 1 energy each, using only the prepared material; no automatic learning completion or immediate execution accompanies approval. The minimal method is manual bending/twisting and joining only where the implemented material contract supports it; cutting, soaking, heating and tool-assisted processing require separately supplied real inputs and mechanisms. No assumed yield ratio: account for every reserved unit as remaining raw material, work-in-progress, finished cord or physical scraps. Length and geometry must follow the implemented material accounting, not be inferred from inventory quantity alone. Insufficient or unsuitable material may yield only an incomplete assembly or scraps.
Products and use: successful formation creates a persistent physical cord/binding item with unique ID, owner, position, input provenance, remaining material quantity, supported geometry, construction method, condition and test history. It is reusable only while physically intact. Its existence is not proof of load capacity, knot security, shelter suitability or safety. Applying it to bind other objects requires a supported attachment interaction, accessible targets and any necessary independently acting participants; do not silently attach it or create a structure.
Bounded test: productId must identify a real accessible cord. One active test round costs 0.5 energy. The minimal fixture-free method is a two-handed pull on a cord whose geometry supports that grip, with a supported measured load ceiling, duration and stop condition. Implement or reuse an explicit effort-to-applied-force and tensile-response mechanism before calling this a load measurement; normalized probe intensity cannot be relabeled as force. Test load must be positive and within both the actor's modeled application limit and the requested ceiling. Do not create weights, anchors, assistants or instruments. If a calibrated hand-pull cannot be supported, return unsupported with no fabricated strength result; a qualitative manipulation may still record its actual observations. A supported test records actual applied load with units, duration, gripping/join configuration, deformation, slipping, rupture and whether the requested load was reached. Held means only that this specimen sustained that measured load for that duration; it is not a breaking-strength estimate or safety certification. Stop on slip, break, loss of grip or inability to apply the requested load. Testing can damage or destroy the item; preserve fragments and their accounted quantities.
Progress and lifecycle: store actor, input reservations, completed work, spent energy, current material state and output references in a persistent process. Only completed work rounds advance progress and charge their costs atomically. Interruption pauses unpaid work; resume requires the same actor, access to the surviving workpiece and renewed eligibility. Cancellation releases remaining reserved material or the actual partial assembly once, never pristine replacements for processed inputs. Death terminates the actor's process and leaves surviving workpiece/material at its physical location under existing death rules. No effort, spent energy, damaged material or elapsed time is refunded; unspent reservations are released exactly once. Prevent duplicate outputs and concurrent use of reserved inputs. Completed items persist without active work, but no autonomous crafting, loading, repair or strengthening occurs. Record condition changes under applicable existing decay/damage rules; do not assume an indefinite lifetime or invent a maintenance interval. Inspection costs one round and 0.2 energy and reports only observable state or retained evidence.
